local({
  income_text <- tolower(`annual income`)
  amount <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", income_text)))
  amount <- if_else(grepl("lakh", income_text), amount * 100000, amount)
  case_when(
    amount < 100 ~ "Unknown",
    amount <= 150000 ~ "Low",
    amount <= 400000 ~ "Medium",
    amount > 400000 ~ "High",
    .default = "Unknown"
  )
})
